name: Pitbit Biga Naerin Nal
source:
The Day It Rained Blood is an adult dark-romance visual novel where you choose between a girl cursed to die each day and a childhood friend blessed by fate. Enter the tragedy beneath the blood rain to save her—or turn from the curse and protect your peaceful life. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5035700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《血雨降临之日》是一款成人向暗黑恋爱视觉小说。你必须在背负着“每日必死”诅咒的少女与受命运眷顾的青梅竹马之间做出抉择：是步入血雨笼罩的悲剧之中拯救她——还是转身远离诅咒，守护自己平静安宁的日常？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5035700/]Steam[/url]]
